status.main_product: Drone-based inspection, surveying, and mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone telecom inspections and telecom tower inspection services under its own brand.
status.evidence: According to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs registry data on ZaubaCorp, Equinox's Drones Private Limited is currently active, and its official website highlights cell tower and telecom inspection services.

claims.claim: Equinox's Drones Pvt Ltd utilizes the AeroSpectrum web-based platform for telecom tower inspections to transform drone-captured data into actionable insights, featuring AI-driven defect detection, high-resolution imagery for cracks, corrosion, and alignment, and 3D visualization.

The company reports the use of custom drones and standard platforms like the DJI Phantom 4 PRO equipped with high-resolution 4K/zoom imaging and thermal sensors to identify structural and mechanical defects on cell towers and utilities without active system downtime.
claims.note: The detail regarding drone inspections specifically on cell towers and utilities without active system downtime using a DJI Phantom 4 PRO could not be confirmed.

claims.claim: The company reports that its thermal and aerial inspection services for cell towers detect up to 16 specific structural and mechanical issues, including concrete basement cracks, insulation or wire overheating, rust, weather damage, and missing components.
claims.note: The claim that the service detects up to 16 specific structural and mechanical issues on cell towers is unverified.

claims.claim: The company reports the development of AeroSpectrum, its proprietary web-based data transformation platform that provides AI-driven defect detection, 3D visualization, and automated analytics to transform drone-captured data into actionable insights for telecom tower inspections.

The company utilizes specialized data reconstruction software, including Pix4D, 3DF Zephyr, and RealityCapture, to process drone imagery, extract frames, and generate 3D models and orthomosaic maps for asset inspection workflows.

The company reports the development of AeroSpectrum, a proprietary web-based data transformation platform that integrates AI-driven defect detection and 3D visualization capabilities for infrastructure including cell tower inspections.

The company reports the implementation of Dronify, an asset and project management software platform that integrates AI/ML digital twin technology, critical infrastructure risk management, and flight software integrations.
The company reports offering a Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) approved, job-oriented drone pilot training course featuring certified expert instructors.
The company reports providing "Pan-India" drone services and operations from its headquarters in Bengaluru, Karnataka, as stated on its official profile.

The company reports operating a premier Drone Pilot Network across its business, delivering over 500 completed projects and surveying more than 1 Lakh acres nationwide across India with over 15 dedicated teams.

The company reports that it offers a DGCA-approved remote pilot training course featuring certified expert instructors and an official training certificate upon completion, as documented on the Equinox's Drones Training Portal.
